sources.snippet: Wav2Vec2-Base-960h Facebook's Wav2Vec2 The base model pretrained and fine-tuned on 960 hours of Librispeech on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16Khz.
